items.reason: Gap 0 describes two in-flight deliveries of the same event both passing the Set check before either records the id, so the handler runs twice.
Gap 2 says dedup uses the unsigned X-Event-Id header and that a signed body replayed with a different header passes verification.
Gap 3 says the provider sends charge.refunded while HANDLERS is keyed refund.created, so real refunds never reach the handler.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas; the restart gap is a single-process crash.
